email_subject: Application - Social Media & Community Marketeer at prado
email_body:
Dear prado team,

I'm writing to apply for the Social Media & Community Marketeer role. Your focus on invisible home technology for architects and your rapid international growth immediately caught my attention.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-driven content, and build WordPress sites for clients. On my own project, mirook.com, I designed the site, integrated social media (Instagram/Facebook), and implemented structured data to improve visibility across search engines and AI platforms. This blend of content creation, community engagement, and technical insight aligns well with your need for someone who can handle multiple brands and markets.

I'm organised, proactive, and eager to learn. I work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level (improving). I'd welcome the chance to contribute to prado's social media presence and community management, especially in the US market.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can support your team.

Warm regards,
